findings.description: The bucket is documented in-line as public with no bucket policy or public access block restricting access, exposing potentially sensitive customer data (customer-master.xlsx) to unauthenticated access over the internet.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket, including the customer master file, are stored unencrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled, which combined with public exposure and force_destroy increases the risk of irreversible data loss or tampering going undetected.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data stored in insecure bucket
findings.description: A customer master data file is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.data, which is unencrypted and documented as public, directly exposing sensitive customer information to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored objects unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is present, so objects in this bucket are stored unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so data science datasets stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.
